purpose: Reach a defensible controlled Knight end-to-end compile demo within the near-term demo window without conflating demo readiness with full shipping/generalization/formal-proof closure.
explicit_nonclaims: all 46 stages exhaustively adversarially closed for every future subject
scope_control_rule: New research questions do not enter P0 merely because they are scientifically interesting. They enter P0 only if they can invalidate the controlled Knight demo claim or corrupt its exported artifact.

required: exact Stage01 source raster/hash binding survives to the Stage07 observation set
no adaptive crop/zoom, alpha erosion, mirror/sign error, pixel-center drift or hidden resize changes foreground support
source-mask/camera round-trip regression catches deliberate crop, padding, Y-flip and pixel-center corruptions before IRIS fit
p0_demo_blockers.reason: Mage demonstrated that an upstream source-ingress corruption can remain hidden until export.

required: V3-native dense source-coverage primitives pass subject-free continuous-field falsification
fresh-init matched-seed Knight Arm A uses exact frozen V3 objective provenance
Arm A learned field passes unchanged Stage13-v2 on all eight source views
source-support outgrowth is within the frozen tolerance
subject-free FORK_GAP/CONCAVE_NOTCH anti-hull-collapse gate remains satisfied

p0_demo_blockers.finding: Stage19 currently inherits dense Stage13 qualification but must directly prove that the actual Stage18/19 candidate/product mesh produced after GSA/relation/CDT still preserves source geometry.
required: reproject the actual qualified product mesh through the exact Stage13 apparatus
apply the same source fidelity/component/negative-space gates or a preregistered equivalent that is at least as strict
fail closed if dense zero-surface PASS does not survive product-mesh materialization
CAA uses exact source-bound donor lineage and total appearance without relighting
rest-pose and motion renders have no undefined appearance, hidden peppering or source-lineage loss
depth ownership and equal-depth tie semantics do not hide the correct surface
exported RSS reload reproduces the qualified source-faithful Knight presentation
p0_demo_blockers.note: Existing subject-free CAA/runtime closures remain valid methodology; P0 needs their actual Knight witness, not another open-ended theoretical red-team expansion.

required: Knight-specific skeleton is editable and correctly bound to the final qualified product mesh
skinning remains stable on final mesh
idle, run and slash execute with the current proper-axis motion semantics
motion does not reveal catastrophic geometry/appearance holes or invalid ownership
p0_demo_blockers.nonrequirement: No claim that the preset motion recipe generalizes to arbitrary unseen characters is needed for the controlled demo.

required: one clean Stage01-to-export run from sealed exact Knight inputs
no cherry-picked intermediate replacement
RSS opens/reloads as editable puppet
idle/run/slash clips are callable after reload
canonical compile report binds source hashes, checkpoint/objective provenance, mesh, CAA and exported RSS hashes

p1_after_demo_or_parallel_if_capacity: second-subject immutable-recipe test before any unseen/generalization claim
new-checkpoint X6C population and runtime numeric rebaseline
full exhaustive 46-stage adversarial red-team beyond demo-critical claim boundaries
promotion_rule: Controlled Knight demo is authorized when every P0 item is PASS on one provenance-sealed end-to-end Knight run. P1 incompleteness must remain explicitly disclosed and must not silently broaden the demo claim.
stop_expansion_rule: Once P0 is green, do not delay the demo to pursue a new P1 research improvement unless new evidence shows that improvement is necessary to keep an existing P0 claim true.
